claims.verdict_history: This step first recorded C7 as refuted. That refutation was itself refuted by an independent cross-verification and is withdrawn; the record below is the corrected judgment. The withdrawn reasoning and why it was wrong are kept under retracted_refutation so the mistake is not silently overwritten.
claims.summary: fingerprintAfter had no not-blind guard, so a camera state that resolves to nothing passed as 'the camera moved'. The state is reachable through an ordinary product interaction, and the guard now added fails on it.

evidence.mechanism: OrbitControls maps a LEFT-button drag with ctrlKey, metaKey or shiftKey held to PAN, not to rotate (node_modules/three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js:1677-1687). enablePan defaults to true (:271) and src/components/viewer/Viewer3D.tsx:1969-1970 sets only enableDamping, so panning is live in the joint viewer. A pan translates the target, so it can take the joint off screen — which orbiting cannot.
evidence.mutation: M6 — the Scenario 7 drag replaced by six repeated Shift-held left-drags across 85% of the canvas, everything else identical to the shipped script

observed.coverage before the pans: 1 of 5 sample points resolve to a rebar
observed.result: the run threw 'UC25 camera evidence blocker: only 0 of 5 sampled points resolve to a rebar after the drag, so the camera is looking at nothing'

evidence.control: the shipped script, whose own drag holds no modifier and therefore orbits, passes all 20 checks on two consecutive runs with coverage unchanged across the drag at both call sites (1/5 -> 1/5 at viewerPerturbation, 4/5 -> 4/5 at displayPerturbation).
evidence.failed_first_attempt: M5 — a single Shift-held pan of 2.2x the canvas width — PASSED, i.e. it did not falsify. Instrumentation showed 4 of 5 points still resolving afterwards at the second call site: one pan of that size merely slid the view onto the 大梁 rather than off the model. A single failed falsification attempt is not evidence that the guard is inert; M6 shows the difference was the size of the displacement, not the mechanism.
evidence.coverage_floor: The guard requires at least 1 of the 5 points to resolve, on both sides. A floor of 3 was tried first and was wrong: coverage is a property of the call site, not of the run — perturbViewer is called twice, and the first call sits at 1 of 5 on a perfectly healthy run, so the floor blocked a passing run. Both values were identical on two consecutive runs; the script now prints them as UC25 CAMERA_ORACLE so a future floor can be set from measurement.

retracted_refutation.what_was_claimed: that the mechanism is unreachable, because 'OrbitControls rotates the camera around the target, so the joint stays in the middle of the canvas however far it is dragged. A left drag cannot take the joint out of view; only a pan or a dolly could, and the script performs neither.'
retracted_refutation.why_it_was_wrong: The premise is false as stated. A left drag CAN pan — OrbitControls.js:1677-1687 routes the left button to pan whenever a modifier key is held. The probe that produced the 'fourteen drags, never blind' measurement held no modifier, so it exercised only the rotate path and could not have reached the state it was looking for. The measurement was real; the generalisation from it was not.
retracted_refutation.how_it_was_caught: An independent cross-verification (Antigravity CLI, run at the user's instruction) read OrbitControls and cited the modifier branch by line. It was confirmed here by reading the same source and then by M6.
retracted_refutation.consequence_of_the_error: step 4 shipped without the C7 guard. It has since been added, and this report is the corrected record.

claims.what_the_guard_cannot_see: tooltipFromHit keys on the schedule row (row:${line.id}), not on the individual bar, so two different bars of the same 部材·役割·径 read identically. A camera move that swaps one bar for a sibling of the same row is invisible to the oracle and, if every sampled point does that, would raise a false 'camera did not move' blocker. This is recorded rather than fixed.
